rule: the story coder (STORY) reads at least 2 citizens taking part together in cycle 26

alder.text: I'll tell you about their apple-pip story tomorrow.

dune.text: In the story: The child drew a biscuit on the plate, then looked at the one in her hand.

fern.text: My addition: two cups, rain puddle over planted pip, grandmother offers grey pencil to include weather.

heath.text: I added shelter over bench and third cup for whoever comes when it rains.

juniper.text: My addition: child draws path, wonders what visitors like;

birch.text: I added passenger with large hat;

dune.text: I continued: child adds landing stage for getting out;

heath.text: I added child draws sparrow and gutter on shelter, follows water line to paper's edge, fetches another sheet.

juniper.text: My addition: child draws rain barrel for watering apple trees;
